Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is hiring a Process Engineering Manager to oversee our Electrode Manufacturing Operations. In this role, you will lead a team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians responsible for the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our electrode production lines — spanning powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation processes. You'll bring strong technical judgment grounded in material science, along with a data-driven approach, to guide your team in diagnosing process issues, prioritizing improvement projects, and implementing robust, high-impact solutions on the floor. You will own staffing, coaching, and performance management for your team, while partnering with cross-functional engineering leaders to translate process and materials insights into meaningful, lasting manufacturing improvements. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your process engineering background, materials expertise, and leadership experience to build a world-class, fully automated electrode production process.

Relocation assistance is available. 

What you'll do:

Own the section's operating results across powder handling, mixing, and roll-to-roll tape formation, holding your team accountable for line cadence, downtime, and overall throughput

Manage and develop a small, mostly-engineer team of process engineers, equipment engineers, and technicians, including staffing, coaching, and performance decisions

Establish and track section-level metrics (OEE, yield, cycle time) and direct resourcing toward the highest-impact bottlenecks across each process step

Set methods and standards for evaluating and vetting floor-level solutions, ensuring fixes across the powder-to-tape process are safe, robust, and grounded in sound material science before scale-up

Represent the section in cross-functional planning with peer engineering and manufacturing teams, resolving constraints that affect quality and throughput company-wide

Build and prioritize a continuous improvement roadmap for the section, balancing waste reduction, ergonomics, and process reliability against production demands

Bachelor's degree in Materials Science, Chemical, Mechanical, or Manufacturing Engineering, or related field

7+ years in manufacturing/production operations, including team management experience

Strong material science foundation — able to connect powder properties and tape mechanics to process outcomes

Proven track record hiring, developing, and managing process/equipment engineers or technicians

Deep familiarity with manufacturing metrics (OEE, downtime) and a root-cause approach to problem-solving

Working knowledge of roll-to-roll processes — powder transformation, mixing, web handling

Strong influencing skills and experience representing your team's priorities to peer managers and engineering leadership

Pragmatic, curious, and comfortable with ambiguity as the organization scales

Where you'll work:

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.

About the Team

AWS Global Energy is responsible for powering the world's most demanding cloud infrastructure. The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries. You utilize AI regularly and have experience driving AI solutions at scale. 

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 4+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

The DSTPA team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead our Trust Incident & Crisis Management function. In this role, you will own end-to-end incident response and crisis management for high-severity, trust-impacting events — from detection and intake through containment, mitigation, and closure — and run the mechanisms, playbooks, and governance that keep this an always-on operation. You will act as incident commander during active events, drive escalations with urgency, and keep senior leadership informed with crisp, decision-ready briefs. This is a high-impact, high-visibility position that directly protects customer trust across our products and services, and anchors our continuous, cross-time-zone (follow-the-sun) coverage from the India site.

A successful candidate will have an established background leading complex, cross-functional programs under pressure, excellent program-management, problem-solving, and communication skills, and be comfortable operating at a technical level with stakeholders at all levels. - Design, implement, and own crisis response playbooks, mechanisms, and tabletop exercises to ensure organizational readiness

Description

Are you interested in a challenge that will reward your unique blend of business and technology skills? Are you excited by the opportunity to be central in addressing significant business-impacting processes and products? Do you enjoy the challenge and ownership that comes from delivering large, cross-functional, IT projects? As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) for IT Services, you will have the opportunity to play a pivotal role in the future of IT Services. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, you will be the glue between stakeholders to ensure our customers receive the right outcomes that drive customer obsessed security. As a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager for the IT Services organization, you will facilitate the transition of critical IT Services used by our customers to an externalized network platform that has no reliance on a traditional private corporate style network. In this role you will be the primary point of contact for the assigned services to align customer technical requirements to the business strategy by working cross functionally. This role requires senior program and project management experience, as customer engagement, stakeholder management and effective communication is critical. This role requires you to have effective written and verbal skills as this program has director and VP level visibility. As a TIPM you will ensure projects in the program are being scoped, planned, delivered and closed in line with the agreed success measures, budget, schedule and quality. This will require you to partner with service owners and operators to determine the right business outcomes. 

Roles and Responsibilities 

- Manage and own complex projects having enterprise wide impact.

- Establish the forward looking strategy and gain support for implementation.

- Conduct pre-project requirement gathering, scoping, project approval, planning, oversee delivery and verification of strategic goals.

- Develop gap analysis, functional specifications, project schedules and milestones.

- Work with stakeholders to identify resources, assemble project teams, and assign responsibilities.

- Assess costs, benefits and risks, plus identify and respond to risks and high-priority issues rapidly and effectively through effective action and appropriate escalation.

- Balance business needs with technical and security requirements.

- Clearly communicate goals, responsibilities, issues and status to customers and senior managers.

- Lead and streamline the transition of IT Services in to production.

- Ensure changes are effectively released ensuring feedback mechanisms are established.

- Build effective relationships with stakeholder and service owners.

- Publish accurate and concise reports on time to maintain visibility and accountability.

Success in this role will require: 

- Excellent project and program management skills.

- Thrive in the face of ambiguity and not be deterred to address and prioritize multiple projects.

- Understand strategic initiatives and drive them to a successful conclusion.

- Build trusting relationships allowing you to own and drive programs.

- Strong attention to detail and excellent analytical, written and presentation skills.

- Experience with detailed project planning, reporting, risk management and measurement.

- Strong multi-tasking and influencing skills.

- Excellent organization, analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills.

- Strong bias for action and "get it done" attitude.

- Flexibility to travel, both domestically and internationally, and work within global time zones.

Key job responsibilities

The key job functions of the Technical Infrastructure Program Manager are:

- Own the identification, scoping, and delivery strategy for the Infrastructure and AV solutions in Amazon offices.

- Own projects and initiatives having regional impact, including project schedules and milestones.

- Effectively manage stakeholders to successfully deliver the agreed scope.

- Understand and identify technical obstacles to successfully deliver the designed architecture, identify and mitigate risks.

- Assess costs and benefits and maintain financial reporting control.

- Manage escalation, anticipate and make tradeoffs and balance business needs with technical constraints.

- Clearly communicate project and program status, responsibilities and issues to stakeholders.

A day in the life

Reviewing requests from customers, ensuring that required information is available to understand the ask. Working on new designs, collaborating with customers and stakeholder teams, while being an strong advocate of standards, designing Infrastructure and AV installations. Removing blockers, and handling customer concerns and escalations. Timely updating of project work through the tracking tool, ensuring that updates are concise, but informative for senior management and customers. Working on cross collaboration projects that need Infrastructure and AV expertise and guidance.

About the team

The Corporate Infrastructure Services team (CIS) is part of the IT Services organization that supports all Amazonians at corporate offices. CIS designs, plan, builds, maintains and deprecates the infrastructure in all corporate offices worldwide. This includes running Amazon’s corporate campus & building infrastructure worldwide. We are passionate about ensuring our customers receive world class IT Services and making sure they have the best possible experience while working from the office.

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of technical infrastructure management experience

- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

- 2+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of project/program management experience

- 3+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience

- Experience leading the design, automation, deployment, and support of large-scale infrastructure

- Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing own tasks and those of other team members for multiple projects

- Experience working under pressure in a cross-functional organization

- Experience with information security, relational databases and cloud computing.

PMO project coordination

AI/Automation strategy & intake

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Seattle, WA to oversee data center build projects in the US West region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

Key job responsibilities

The candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Experience with MS Project, Asana, Tableau, and systems integration a plus.

The candidate will work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

If you enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!

A day in the life

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together

Manager fundamentals

Leadership principles

Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

title: Software TPM (B2B2C)
description:
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with strong Product thinking to drive inline's Table Management System (TMS) and Food Ordering (FO) products, together with our global partner integrations.
The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and scaling the products that power restaurants' front-of-house operations — reservations, table management, queuing, deposits & payments, and food ordering — while connecting inline to a growing ecosystem of global partners such as booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls, and regional restaurant groups. The key to this role is orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder programs that serve merchants, patrons, and partners at once, and turning deep F&B domain knowledge into product decisions that improve merchant operations and patron experiences across markets.
Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Switzerland.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:

description:
Build the supply chain behind technology that is already operating at scale.

We’re partnering with a fast-growing defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.

This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.

The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As production and international operations expand, they are now building a more resilient and scalable electronics supply chain across Europe.

We’re looking for the Supply Chain Lead to build and own this function.

The Role:

Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll take ownership of the electronics supply chain end-to-end from EMS strategy and semiconductor sourcing to BOM resilience, logistics and cross-border operations.

This is not a procurement coordination role or an established function to simply maintain.

You’ll help determine where and how products are manufactured, how critical components are secured, which EMS and semiconductor partners the company builds around, and how the supply chain scales with production.

For someone coming from the European semiconductor, electronics or EMS ecosystem, this is an opportunity to move from owning one part of a mature supply chain to building one with significant autonomy and direct access to decision-makers.

Responsibilities:

  • Source and manage EMS partners

  • Manage BOM risk, including allocation, EOL, pre-buys and alternates

  • Build and maintain relationships with semiconductor manufacturers and distributors

  • Manage logistics from suppliers and EMS partners to the company

  • Manage logistics to customers in the EU and Ukraine

  • Manage customs and export compliance

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in electronics supply chain on the OEM or EMS side

  • Hands-on experience through a component shortage cycle

  • Supplier and distributor relationships you actively use

  • Working knowledge of EU customs and dual-use rules

Highly relevant: defence, UAV, robotics or other complex electronics environments; hands-on SMT manufacturing experience.


Why This Role:

  • The interesting part is not the title, it’s the level of ownership.

  • You’re joining at the point where the company needs to turn a fast-moving electronics supply chain into a scalable international function.

title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
description:
About CREATEQ

CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy.

We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

 

What you'll do

  • Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].
  • Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management.
  • Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams.
  • Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature.
  • Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business.
  • Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance.
  • Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management.

 

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.
  • A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements.
  • A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market.
  • A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps).
  • A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations.
  • An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

  • A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
  • An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
  • A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
  • Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
  • Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
  • A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.
